description: This Java class 'KeyStoreFactory' manages SSL context creation, keystore loading/creation, and certificate handling for TLS connections within the mockserver project.

classes.name: KeyStoreFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing SSL contexts and keystores, including certificate handling for TLS in the mockserver environment.

methods.name: sslContext
methods.description: Returns an SSLContext, creating it if necessary, with optional parameters for custom key and trust certificates.

methods.name: loadOrCreateKeyStore
methods.description: Loads an existing keystore from file or creates a new one if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: getSSLContextInstance
methods.description: Retrieves an SSLContext instance with TLSv1.2 protocol, falling back to TLSv1 if unavailable.

methods.name: savePrivateKeyAndX509InKeyStore
methods.description: Saves a private key and associated certificates into a keystore and persists it to disk.
